releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.3 - Myanmar Language + Active Session Navy Badge
releaseNotes:
• 🇲🇲 BURMESE LANGUAGE FILL: bottom-navigation tabs (Home/Vouchers/Sessions/Settings), Dashboard menu cards and subtitles (Portal Themes, App Flow Control, AP counts, Sell More, Online), and Active Sessions texts (AP/Bridge banner + empty search) are now fully translated when the app is in Myanmar.
• 🔢 LIVE ACTIVE-SESSION BADGE: the 'Sessions' tab in the bottom bar now shows the current number of active customers on a badge, visible immediately when you open the app.
• 🧭 CRASH FIX: removed the duplicate 'Active Sessions' shortcut from the Dashboard menu — it pointed to a route that no longer existed and crashed the app when tapped (Sessions is already your bottom tab).
• 🔒 v1.10.2 layout fix + v1.10.1 exact voucher tabs + safe cleanup preserved.

Install over v1.10.2/v1.10.1/v1.9.2 — same signature, no uninstall.
